title: Prepare C4 high-precision regulator schedule
objective: Implement fail-atomic source-transparent preparation of the field3 candidate regulator and L schedule from an eventual complete C3 A owner at 153088/153152 bits, explicitly pending analytic acceptance and without consuming frozen 192-bit answers
dependencies: complete authenticated C3 3x13 logarithm owner at 153088 or 153152 bits
field-derived h*invhr owner for PARI bad_check and retry acceptance

handoff.summary: Prepared a fail-atomic ordinary-Python C4 coordinator that authenticates the eventual C3 owner, preserves source ordering, derives the regulator multiple and candidate L/R at both target precisions, and explicitly leaves analytic acceptance pending. Lifted the connected packed-real validation corridor, added a fresh PARI 2.17.4 reconstruction differential, high-precision fallback probes, and authority mutation tests. No real field-3 mathematical owner is published and no heavy native build was run.
risks: The real complete C3 A owner does not yet exist, so only synthetic target-precision execution is exercised.
The permitted inputs do not contain PARI's field-derived h*invhr factor; bad_check(z*R), acceptance, and precision retry remain downstream.

The full pnpm test:baselib:strict wrapper is blocked by a pre-existing doubled-backtick docstring in field3_high_precision_hnf_transform.py outside this lane; the underlying strict CPython/Ruff/Pyright checker passes with zero errors.
next_steps: Bind the real complete C3 owner hash/generation/order to this coordinator and replay at 153088 bits, escalating only via the explicit 153152-bit retry protocol.
Add an authenticated field-derived h*invhr derivation and PARI bad_check replay before promoting candidate L/R to accepted owners.
Only then hand the accepted L/R owners to cleanarch/getfu.
